opportunities.opportunity_id: Main Grants (Research, Development and Analysis Fund)
opportunities.title: Main Grants (Research, Development and Analysis Fund)

amount.raw: Up to £500,000 for research that addresses one or more of the priority questions outlined in our Strategic Review. In special cases, and by prior agreement, we accept applications for up to £750,000. Most of the grants we award are below £300,000.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Proposals must address one or more of the Nuffield Foundation's priority questions. The team must have the appropriate experience, expertise, and potential. Projects led by individuals unaffiliated to any particular organization, schools, further education colleges, undergraduates, or master’s students are not eligible. PhD fees or projects where the main purpose is to support a PhD are also not eligible.
opportunities.summary: Funding for research projects that address one or more of the Nuffield Foundation's five interconnected priorities and aim to improve lives in the UK.

opportunities.title: Racial Diversity UK Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants from diverse backgrounds, particularly from racially minoritised communities, are encouraged. Partnership applications which bring together researchers and racially minoritised communities are strongly encouraged.
opportunities.summary: Research funding to understand the barriers and pathways to a racially just and inclusive society.
